name: dgVoodoo2
redistribution: Official readme permits individual dgVoodoo files to ship with a game or game mod; standalone redistribution requires the complete ZIP.
qualification: Defender-clean wrapper archive and extracted-tree scan. On the Vengeance field tree, the stock 2.87.5 x86 wrappers kept Windows at 2560x1440, rendered a centered 1920x1440 4:3 surface, and showed no watermark. Exact-window captures on a 2560x1440 display proved that the embedded Microsoft/FASA segment remained centered and uncropped at 4:3, while only the later GAMEOPEN.MPG live-action segment received proportional 30:17 cover presentation across the final display target. The following 4:3 menu remained untouched. The source-built D3D12 add-on was reproduced byte-for-byte twice at its two-source-pixel crop revision. The 2026-09-24 profile revision withdraws dynamic max_4_3 enumeration and unsupported 900, 960, 1080, and 1440 render heights after F: Vengeance mission crashes and exact executable HUD-table inspection in all three titles. The profile hash remains pinned. The gameplay-only bottom-right-anchored crop is reduced from five to two source pixels based on the retained 2-3 display-pixel seam measurement at 1920x1440; a fresh mission capture must still prove seam removal and edge preservation. Black Knight/Mercenaries gameplay and additional GPU coverage remain open.
